# PanelPay

> PanelPay is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0) control panel and billing system for reselling Amazon Lightsail: a prepaid wallet, a double-entry ledger, automatic provisioning of servers, databases, storage, CDN, DNS and domains across many AWS accounts, built with TypeScript, Next.js, PostgreSQL and SST. Created by S M Moshiur Rahman (https://www.linkedin.com/in/in-moshiur). Status: pre-launch, proven on staging, not yet taking real payments in production. It is not affiliated with AWS or WHMCS, and it gives no right to resell AWS.

PanelPay is an alternative to a general-purpose billing platform such as WHMCS for one job: selling AWS Lightsail resources with a prepaid wallet. It is not a WHMCS module.
